page_title: PAU 0-2 DOR | St. Pauli v Dortmund 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The resulting corner from Eric Smith (St. Pauli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+2' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Serhou Guirassy walks off the pitch to be replaced by Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
89' The game has come to an end for Maximilian Beier. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Noah Weisshaupt will be replaced by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
83' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Lars Ritzka and he is replaced by Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli).
83' The substitution has been made. Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) has replaced Karim Adeyemi.
82' What was Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
82' Tobias Stieler blows for a foul after Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
79' Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
79' Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Stieler blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Dortmund.
77' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) has a goal ruled out for offside!
74' That's the end of the game for Giovanni Reyna, who is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund).
74' The substitution is prepared. Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ramy Bensebaini.
73' Here is a change. Johannes Eggestein is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).

72' Serhou Guirassy plays a pass to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
69' The ball possession is 40:60. The shots on goal statistics – 0:3. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:12.
66' One of the players from St. Pauli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
65' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
58' 0 - 2 Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Nikola Vasilj with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:2.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Elias Saad.

57' Yan Couto (Dortmund) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Stieler saw the whole situation. St. Pauli win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
53' That's a well-taken pass by Yan Couto (Dortmund). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
50' 0 - 1 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
47' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' A dangerous looking corner kick from Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) is cleared to safety by the defence.
42' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
42' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
40' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Stieler has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. St. Pauli have a free kick.
36' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.

35' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
34' Tobias Stieler couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) and blew his whistle.
28' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

27' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. St. Pauli can continue in their attacking effort.

27' Direct free kick. Eric Smith (St. Pauli) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat. St. Pauli will take a corner kick.
26' Emre Can (Dortmund) brings his opponent down. Tobias Stieler has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to St. Pauli.
25' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
25' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

24' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom of the right post is denied by a decent save from Nikola Vasilj.
22' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement. St. Pauli get a free kick.
18' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
18' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) is flagged for offside after the defenders execute the offside trap perfectly.
17' Yan Couto (Dortmund) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Stieler no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to St. Pauli.

14' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
14' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) is about to take a corner kick.
14' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Eric Smith (St. Pauli), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and St. Pauli manage to earn a corner.
13' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
13' Tobias Stieler blows the whistle, Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is penalised for a foul. St. Pauli have a free kick.
10' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) handles the ball inside the box. It's a free kick to Dortmund in a dangerous position.
9' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
7' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Noah Weisshaupt just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

6' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
5' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) will deliver the corner kick.
5' A lofted cross from Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli win a corner kick.
4' Referee Tobias Stieler sees the trip by David Nemeth (St. Pauli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Tobias Stieler will referee today's match.
